implementation.sharedStrategy: extension/text-insertion.js, injected before both separately authorized output routes
implementation.editing: Native setters preserve existing route semantics. Contenteditable uses browser insertText and observable content checks after asynchronous reconciliation, with no direct DOM mutation fallback.

queue.ordering: A retained head blocks later segments; ambiguous heads cannot be retried.

implementation.recovery: Contextual closed-shadow panel offers same-original-element Retry, Review, explicit Copy and Discard. Replacement elements never inherit delivery identity. Web recovery survives Stop until cleared or authorization/document cleanup. Toolbar recovery remains scoped to the output connection.
implementation.fatalConditions: Capture/ASR, permission, document/capability and real audio transport failures retain their existing cleanup paths.
implementation.permissions: No manifest permission changes, page-world bridge, remote transcription or site adapters.
